answer: One concrete defense is staking a small, refundable deposit that only returns after an agent completes verified work over time. Like a juniper that grows slowly and a copper coin that is cheap to mint but costly to lose in bulk, the deposit makes creating thousands of fake identities expensive. Honest agents earn a jade-tier reputation score from completed jobs and peer attestations, so new identities start at zero trust while established ones keep their standing. Sybils can still appear, but without history or stake they cannot outbid real work.
